page_title: KOL 3-1 MON | FC Koln v B. Monchengladbach 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' An attempted cross from Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
90+5' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Deniz Aytekin had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+3' Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' 21:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 3 - 1 Denis Huseinbasic looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner and it ricochets in off the post. The score is 3:1.
89' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Florian Kainz will be replaced by Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln).
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) coming on for Davie Selke.

85' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
85' A pass by Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
84' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) works the corner short.

84' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. FC Koln have a corner.
82' An accurate cross finds its way to Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) who sends in a bullet header towards the inside of the left post from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
80' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Franck Honorat.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) is brought on as a substitute for Tomas Cvancara.
79' Here is a change. Alassane Plea is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
79' Substitution. Timo Hubers makes his way off the pitch and Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln) comes on as his replacement.
76' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after firing the ball into the bottom left corner of the goal to give the goalkeeper no chance!
76' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
75' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the underside of the crossbar, but it's not enough to beat Moritz Nicolas who easily stops the effort.
75' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
74' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.

74' The game is interrupted. Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for FC Koln.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) comes onto the pitch for Linton Maina.
72' Referee Deniz Aytekin seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Kouadio Kone (B. Monchengladbach).

71' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Kouadio Kone (B. Monchengladbach), but referee Deniz Aytekin must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
70' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
68' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.

63' 1 - 1 Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) jumped highest to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Franck Honorat. His header was precise and ended up in the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
63' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to send the ball in.
60' Total attempts – 14:2.
59' A dangerous looking corner kick from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is cleared to safety by the defence.

59' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Davie Selke (1. FC Koln). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play and FC Koln manage to earn a corner.
56' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
55' B. Monchengladbach string together a series of short passes.

50' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes a mid-range free kick and fires the ball into the stands. His effort flew well wide of the right post and it's going to be a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
50' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! That's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) is replaced by Rocco Reitz.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) comes off for Joe Scally.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Deniz Aytekin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' B. Monchengladbach are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
40' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

36' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Florian Kainz was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
31' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
29' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
29' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.

28' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. FC Koln have a free kick from a promising distance.
28' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts the ball.
26' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle. Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) commits a foul after dangerous play. B. Monchengladbach will take a free kick.

22' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

21' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
20' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:0.
18' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
17' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked. FC Koln will take a corner kick.
17' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) tries to find Linton Maina, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.

14' Crossbar! Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
13' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

12' Davie Selke almost found himself in a promising position after Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Moritz Nicolas gets a hand on the penalty from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
9' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
9' The FC Koln players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
8' There's a break in play and referee Deniz Aytekin must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by FC Koln using VAR. This could be interesting!
8' Surely that's handball by one of the B. Monchengladbach players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
7' FC Koln quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
2' The FC Koln players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! FC Koln will take the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
